statements.status_notes: A TLS server whose sni_callback switches SSLSocket.context to another SSLContext could crash or call through a freed pointer when nothing else kept the original context alive, triggerable by a remote unauthenticated client. Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/156293 (3.13 commit https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/d8717ed01717a9641686e6e6f83f0ab8af235e2c), first released in CPython 3.13.16; see the advisory https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/QMQIUQB6WGGC3MI7I3WKQXOYOBDSPPS3/ and https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-19445. The DHI Alpine 3.23 python-3.13 package first ships the fix in 3.13.16-r0, built from CPython 3.13.16 (the version string in libpython3.13.so). Checked the _ssl extension module in every published build on x86_64 and aarch64 (3.13.12-r0 to 3.13.18-r4): from 3.13.16-r0 on it has the extra servername-callback reset the fix adds when an SSLContext is freed and no longer sets the callback argument (one more SSL_CTX_callback_ctrl call site and one fewer SSL_CTX_ctrl call site than in 3.13.12-r0 to 3.13.15-r2); this fix is the only change to Modules/_ssl.c between CPython 3.13.15 and 3.13.16.

A TLS server whose sni_callback switches SSLSocket.context to another SSLContext could crash or call through a freed pointer when nothing else kept the original context alive, triggerable by a remote unauthenticated client. Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/156293 (3.14 commit https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/cd7e51e7d4563866fbaa1e2521ae69b45daf3698), first released in CPython 3.14.8; see the advisory https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/QMQIUQB6WGGC3MI7I3WKQXOYOBDSPPS3/ and https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-19445. The DHI Alpine 3.23 python-3.14 package first ships the fix in 3.14.8-r0, built from CPython 3.14.8 (the version string in libpython3.14.so). Checked the _ssl extension module in every published build on x86_64 and aarch64 (3.14.3-r0 to 3.14.10-r4) by its calls into OpenSSL: the fix removes the only SSL_CTX_set_tlsext_servername_arg call in Modules/_ssl.c (an SSL_CTX_ctrl call with SSL_CTRL_SET_TLSEXT_SERVERNAME_ARG), which handed OpenSSL a borrowed pointer to the SSLContext. 3.14.3-r0 to 3.14.7-r2 still contain that call, as the upstream CPython 3.14.7 and earlier source does; 3.14.8-r0 and later do not.
